name: GreenMail Open-Source Email Testing
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed sandbox email test servers supporting SMTP, POP3 and IMAP, embedded in Java tests or run as a standalone process/container; no software usage quota or hosted mail allowance.
watch_out: Designed for email integration tests, not production mail delivery. Requires Java or container runtime and user-provided CI/compute resources; sandbox messages are not forwarded to real recipients. Infrastructure and CI usage can incur costs.
